news_summary: Bank Islam August 26 issuer-authored Bursa summary shows Q2 attributable profit increasing to RM139.122 million from RM126.685 million, while H1 profit increased only 0.5%. The summary is accessed through a third-party mirror; original attachments and detailed supplement remain blocked, so the modest quarterly recovery does not establish broad improving sentiment.
